slice_preflight.method: Decimal-centered triangle-plane intersections; endpoint weld tolerance 1e-7 mm; Shapely closed odd-even polygons, not extrusion toolpaths

overhang_preflight.criterion: down-facing triangles >45 degrees from vertical, excluding display base bottom

practical_features.display_scale: 4 mm per approximate design-metre; high main length 165.6 mm, overall length about 250 mm including limited base
support_required_under: upper facade overhang above left lower recess
practical_features.warning: Thin frames/rails are enlarged abstractions, not exact construction dimensions. Resin or further enlargement may be needed. Supports, orientation, nozzle and color workflow must be assessed in a slicer.

limitations: Numerical preflight is not a support-free print guarantee.
Thin rails, frames and external stairs need slicer/support assessment; enlarge or use resin as appropriate.
Solid interiors/opaque glazing are intentionally simplified; total solid mesh volume is not filament consumption.
No exact terrain, shared basement, structural analysis, current-state verification or surveyed architectural scale.
